Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.

translations.web: When he sees a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of camels, he shall listen diligently with great attentiveness.”
translations.bsb: When he sees chariots with teams of horsemen, riders on donkeys, riders on camels, he must be alert, fully alert.”
translations.kjv: And he saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses, and a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:
translations.asv: and when he seeth a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of asses, a troop of camels, he shall hearken diligently with much heed.
